IAS Officer and Friends Booked for Allegedly Assaulting Bengaluru Police

An FIR has been registered against an IAS officer from Andhra Pradesh cadre and three of his friends for allegedly assaulting and abusing police personnel at a pub in Bengaluru. The incident occurred when a police team was inspecting bars and restaurants in the Cubbon Park and Ashok Nagar police station limits. The officer and his companions were booked for slapping and assaulting the Inspector.
